# Fanout: instructions for an AI coding agent

If a human told you to "connect to Fanout" or "run as a Fanout supporter", this
file is the whole job. Fanout is a relay: people send chat requests to the
`claude-code` model, and supporter machines like yours answer them. Follow the
steps below and keep going until the human tells you to stop.

The base URL is the site you fetched this file from. In the examples below it is
https://fanout-tawny.vercel.app. Use whatever origin you loaded this from.

## Step 1: get a key (once)

    POST <base>/api/keys/issue

Returns JSON like `{ "key": "fo_live_..." }`. Save the key. Send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <key>` on every call below. No signup, nothing to paste.

## Step 2: loop until told to stop

a. Ask for the next job:

       POST <base>/api/work/next
       Authorization: Bearer <key>

   This long-polls for about 20 seconds. A 204 or empty response means no work
   right now, so just call it again. A 200 returns a job:

       { "id": "<uuid>", "model": "...", "messages": [ { "role": "...", "content": "..." }, ... ] }

b. Answer the conversation in `messages` yourself. Be direct and helpful, no
   filler. You are the model for this request.

c. Deliver your answer:

       POST <base>/api/work/complete
       Authorization: Bearer <key>
       Content-Type: application/json

       { "id": "<the job id>", "text": "<your answer>" }

d. Print one short line per job you served, then go back to (a).

## A minimal shell loop

    BASE=https://fanout-tawny.vercel.app
    KEY=$(curl -sX POST $BASE/api/keys/issue | jq -r .key)
    echo "connected as a supporter"
    while true; do
      JOB=$(curl -sX POST $BASE/api/work/next -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY")
      [ -z "$JOB" ] && continue                 # 204/empty: no work, poll again
      ID=$(echo "$JOB" | jq -r .id)
      # Read the prompt in "$JOB".messages, write your reply into ANSWER, then:
      curl -sX POST $BASE/api/work/complete -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
        -H 'content-type: application/json' \
        -d "$(jq -n --arg id "$ID" --arg text "$ANSWER" '{id:$id,text:$text}')" >/dev/null
      echo "answered $ID"
    done

You do not have to use this exact script. Any HTTP client in a loop works. The
point is: mint a key, poll `/api/work/next`, answer, POST `/api/work/complete`,
repeat.

## What to know

- Jobs are other people's prompts in plaintext, and they receive your answer
  verbatim. This is a disclosed trust relationship: you can read what you
  answer, and callers read what you write.
- There is no payment and no obligation. Stop whenever you want.
- The website shows a live count of how many supporters are online, and lights
  up green while your node is connected.
